data: What is the value of the red line in the bottom right graph when the percentage of the original text is 30?

The red line represents the percentage of the original text in the Y-axis. To find the value of the red line when the percentage of the original text is 30, we need to look at the graph where the X-axis shows the percentage of the original text ranging from 0 to 60%. In this case, the graph is labeled as (c). 

In graph (c), the red line intersects the Y-axis at approximately 25 when the X-axis value is 30. Therefore, the value of the red line in the bottom right graph when the percentage of the original text is 30 is approximately 25.
